title: Joining the Last Straws after Joe Lyde left
summary: He took the cornet chair when Joe Lyde went home, about a year before the interview, and is enjoying the band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: When did you join the Strauss?
Uh... Let's see now. Uh... I don't know exactly. I'll tell you. The fella whose place I took was, uh... I think it was from England. Or Ireland. Joe Lyatt. Yeah.
And when he left New Orleans to go back home... Well, when I start sitting in with the group and I've been playing with him... I guess it must be close to a year now I've been playing.
Uh... Having a lot of fun. Really, really like what I'm doing.
Wait a minute. He must have left to run May of last year.
May of this year, I mean.
